mechanism.finding: Caller cancellation and timeout abort a local controller. ResponseControl retains the caller abort listener until body cleanup. readSse awaits reader.read and does not directly cancel/release the reader. Native fetch is relied on to error the response body.
Desktop POST stream:true goes to backend.providerStream using the caller signal. The non-stream proxy races frontend waiting against abort but does not cancel native provider_request.

Cancellation immediately errors the frontend ReadableStream, sends provider_stream_cancel, clears queued chunks, and ignores late events. This can finish UI/agent waiting while the native request is still alive.
The cancel command only sets an AtomicBool. The blocking worker, HTTP response, and streams-map entry remain until execute_stream returns.

Flag checks occur only after headers and before each blocking read. Setting the flag cannot wake a pending read. Production read budget is 60000ms; whole-loop deadline is 180000ms. The read error is converted into timeout before another cancellation check.

The 180000ms explicit deadline is checked between reads only. A read started just before that deadline can wait an additional read-budget interval. A strict 180000ms wall-clock cap is not proven by this code; overshoot is source-derived and not a long-run measurement.
Browser dev and tests select the memory mock backend. The desktop product model transport is IPC plus Rust; it is not Node Undici.

priorEvidenceBoundaries.implication: cancelledResult true proves frontend cancellation behavior, not prompt source transport cancellation.

priorEvidenceBoundaries.finding: OpenAI idle sends one initial delta and retains its response for 120000ms. close handlers only clear timers and do not emit connection-closure evidence.
Cleanup deletes the WebDriver session/stops the driver before stopping the fixture. App exit can close remaining native connections; fixture exit cannot prove cancellation closed them earlier.
Uses direct Node fetch and only asserts an AbortError; this is not Tauri native transport proof.
Synthetic ReadableStream tests manually error the controller on signal abort. They test error normalization and listener retention; they do not exercise Undici or Rust socket cancellation.

recommendedFollowup.implementation: Use async reqwest and an explicit cancellation wake mechanism. Race cancellation against both request send and body chunk reads; drop the response on cancellation; retain incremental redaction and partial-output semantics.
recommendedFollowup.cancelState: A watch channel or cancellation token avoids lost wakeups. If Notify plus AtomicBool is used, register the waiter before checking the state and verify race handling.
recommendedFollowup.timeouts: Keep separate read-idle and total-deadline budgets; use async reqwest total timeout or a selected absolute deadline for a strict wall-clock budget.
recommendedFollowup.avoid: Do not shrink the read timeout to a polling interval and swallow/retry timeout errors: that can break valid slow responses and resumed-read semantics.
